surface_mechanism_description: The processes of surface adsorption and reaction of GeH4 on Si substrates were separated by use of a Xe flash lamp to heat the surface in an ultraclean low-pressure environment. Single atomic layer deposition of Ge per flash lamp light shot has been realized. It is found that the surface coverage velocity of Ge-hydrides is higher at a higher GeH4 partial pressure and that the density of adsorbed Ge-hydrides becomes nearly equal to that of the adsorption equilibrium surface density in the investigated GeH4 partial pressure range.
